name: Specification selection pass rate
purpose: Measures whether a request is answered with the records it concerns (and with nothing when no record concerns it) without returning a crowd, over the real index of the ESOI repository's records, with a real cheap-model judge and a real local vector search.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each implementation on the same labelled requests (every expected id present, no more than a ceiling returned), per kind, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash. Every model call is a real one, so a run costs real tokens and the pass rate moves a little between runs. The scripted-judge plumbing checks (batching, invented ids, failed calls) are unit tests, not this metric. The leaderboard ranks the arms by a balanced score of accuracy, cost and time, weighted in esoi.toml [balance.spec_selection].
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the lexical_vector offline arm of spec_selection runs the whole case set with no model call, validating the cases and scorer before any model is paid for] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > live [real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=a person approved the spend under the metric run policy]
command: esoi run spec_selection --impl lexical_vector_gated; esoi run spec_selection --impl lexical_vector_llm; esoi run spec_selection --impl lexical_vector; esoi run spec_selection --impl lexical_only

name: Work classification: the deliverable filed under the right solution
purpose: Part 1 of work quality: the work a milestone needs is classified to the solution it belongs to (picked among the quest's records, or created when none fits), so the deliverable has its own records, metric and rubric.
record: Share of progress-case replay runs whose deliverable was filed under a solution whose name holds one of the case's expected_solution_terms (a created solution read from the run's recorded insert, else the solution the queued brief names). Every run weighs the same; fixed before scoring.
disadvantages: A picked existing solution is seen only through the brief's 'The solution:' line, which older briefs lack; the expected terms are a keyword set per case.
cascading_conditionals: offline [real=no | sample=full | gate=all-pass | when=saved overlay replay records of the progress cases are scored by code, no model call and no new chat turn] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=one progress case is replayed end to end on the overlay (its queued task run the way the lane runs it) and its record is scored and hand-read]

name: ESOI application: the deliverable meets its solution's own rubric
purpose: Part 2 of work quality: the agent carrying out ESOI on the solution produces a deliverable that meets the solution's own rubric, measured by a separate check before and after.
record: Share of runs with a measured increment whose after is above its before (in the turn, or on the queued task's completion) and no failed DELIVERABLE RUBRIC item in the judge's verdict. Every run weighs the same; fixed before scoring. Each failing judged item is attributed to one part by work_parts.ITEM_PARTS.
disadvantages: Uses the judge's item verdicts as recorded; a run whose keep was refused in the replay is measured on its attempted keep.
cascading_conditionals: offline [real=no | sample=full | gate=all-pass | when=saved overlay replay records of the progress cases are scored by code, no model call and no new chat turn] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=one progress case is replayed end to end on the overlay (its queued task run the way the lane runs it) and its record is scored and hand-read]

name: Harness: the work ran to a deliverable within its budget
purpose: Part 3 of work quality: the harness the work runs on (the deep agent the cascade selected, or the in-turn writer when none is wired) finishes with a deliverable within its budget.
record: Share of runs whose queued task produced a deliverable (a measured body or an attempted keep, no run error), or, with nothing queued, whose in-turn depth loop did not stop on its budget. Every run weighs the same; fixed before scoring.
disadvantages: Does not yet weigh the run's time or cost; a deliverable that exists but is thin counts here and fails part 2.
cascading_conditionals: offline [real=no | sample=full | gate=all-pass | when=saved overlay replay records of the progress cases are scored by code, no model call and no new chat turn] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=one progress case is replayed end to end on the overlay (its queued task run the way the lane runs it) and its record is scored and hand-read]
